fields.description: Issue includes political commentary on Dade County and Miami Beach politics, including Miami Beach election history and coverage of the June 7, 1949 Miami Beach City Council race (including candidate Ernest Woolfe and a campaign item for Aaron Courshon). Editorials criticize high milk prices as an effective tax and discuss broader tax concerns, gambling enforcement debates, and alleged manipulation of municipal utilities involving Florida Power & Light and the Miami Water Board. Local news items address Miami employment declines with continued building activity, a dispute over alleged anti-union hiring at a grocery, traffic safety and railroad crossing warnings, Jewish War Veterans memorial services, and national political lobbying around Taft-Hartley legislation.
